probes.description: Render headings, emphasis, links, nested lists and tilde-fenced code with commonmark 0.31.2

provenance: Source Authority Ladder snapshots plus one controlled local Node probe; no external example API calls.

questions.question: Jak działają podstawowe bloki i elementy inline oraz fenced code blocks w CommonMark?
Które elementy są rozszerzeniami GFM i dlaczego trzeba nazwać dialekt?

excerpts.text: A document contains block structures such as paragraphs, headings, lists and code blocks, whose content can contain inline elements.
A fenced code block starts with at least three consecutive backticks or tildes; the two fence characters cannot be mixed.
Inline links place the destination and optional title directly after link text.
GFM is a strict superset of CommonMark and marks its additional features as extensions.
Tables, strikethrough and task list items are defined as GFM extensions rather than CommonMark core syntax.
